# Documentation build dependencies (Sphinx + MyST toolchain).
# Install into a docs venv:  python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
# The gigalens package itself does NOT need to be importable — heavy deps are
# mocked in conf.py — but `pip install -e .` (without the CUDA extra) makes the
# version string and any un-mocked imports resolve cleanly.
sphinx>=7.3
# Light, CPU-only runtime deps that execute at import time (numpy/scipy constants,
# jnp.pi, etc.) — too pervasive to mock safely, so install the real thing. jax is
# pinned to the package's version for import compatibility; the CPU wheel is enough
# (no GPU). The heavy stack (tensorflow, lenstronomy, objax) stays mocked in conf.py.
numpy
scipy
jax[cpu]==0.6.2
myst-parser>=3.0
myst-nb>=1.1
linkify-it-py>=2.0          # required by the MyST "linkify" extension (bare-URL autolinking)
pydata-sphinx-theme>=0.15
sphinx-copybutton>=0.5
sphinx-design>=0.6
# Optional static-analysis reference backend (see docs/README.md); uncomment to use:
# sphinx-autodoc2>=0.5
